========

```{r echo = FALSE}
all_levels <- unique(d$Skalenniveau)

n_answeropts <- 5  # number of answer options

# Draw sample of items:

d_sample <- sample_n(d, size = n_answeropts)  %>%  # draw sample of items/questions
  # mutate(Skalenniveau = factor(Skalenniveau)) %>% 
  select(Variable, Skalenniveau) %>% 
  sample_n(size = n_answeropts) %>% 
  mutate(is_correct_item = 
           sample(x = c(1, rep.int(0, times = n_answeropts-1)),
                  size = n_answeropts))  # choose item that will be the correct one



# conduct some tests:
expect_equal(nrow(d_sample), 5)
expect_equal(ncol(d_sample), 3)



# Declare if item is correct or false:

d_declared <- 
  d_sample %>% 
  rowwise() %>% 
  mutate(wrong_scale_level = keep(all_levels, ~ .x != Skalenniveau) %>%
           sample(size = 1)) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(presented_scale_level = if_else(is_correct_item == 1, Skalenniveau, wrong_scale_level ))


# Prepare items for presentation:

d_prepared <-
  d_declared %>% 
  mutate(item = glue("Die Variable `{Variable}` ist vom Typ `{presented_scale_level}`.")) %>% 
  mutate(is_true = is_correct_item == 1) %>% 
  mutate(order_presented = 1:nrow(.))


```


```{r questionslist, echo = FALSE, results = "asis"}
exams::answerlist(d_prepared$item, markup = "markdown")
```




Solution
========


Die Skalenniveaus der präsentierten Variablen lauten wie folgt:


```{r echo = FALSE}
d_prepared %>% 
  arrange(order_presented) %>% 
  select(Variable, Skalenniveau) %>% 
gt::gt()
```


Dementsprechend lauten die Lösungen zu den Items:


Aufgabenname: `skalenniveau1`



```{r solutionlist, echo = FALSE, results = "asis"}
exams::answerlist(ifelse(d_prepared$is_correct_item, "Richtig", "Falsch"), markup = "markdown")
```
